balls.commentary: Arya opens the face and guides a good length delivery to deep backward point.
Singh stands tall and punches a back of a length delivery to deep backward point.
Singh stays back and defends a back of a length delivery watchfully.
Singh cuts a short and wide delivery to deep backward point for a single.
Arya flashes hard at a short ball that kicked off the deck and misses.
Arya goes for the hook, hits it in the air towards deep square leg and is caught by Malinga.
Prabhsimran Singh goes for a lofted drive, leading edge caught by Pat Cummins at cover.
Shreyas Iyer slaps a short and wide delivery to sweeper cover for four.
Shreyas Iyer defends a good length delivery to the off side.
Shreyas Iyer taps a back of a length delivery to backward point for a single.
Cooper Connolly flashes hard at a back of a length delivery and misses.
Cooper Connolly mistimes a drive to mid-on for a single.
Connolly slays a back of a length delivery square of the wicket for four.
Connolly punches a short ball off the back foot square of the wicket for two runs.
Connolly punches a probing delivery towards mid off for no run.
Cummins bowls a no ball, a slower short delivery that beats Connolly.
Connolly slices a full delivery over deep point for a six on the freehit.
Connolly defends a back of a length delivery to the off side.
Connolly digs out a yorker length delivery towards point.
Iyer drives a full delivery towards mid on.
Shreyas Iyer attempts an inside-out lofted drive over cover but slices it to mid off, caught by Pat Cummins.
Stoinis defends a back of a length delivery towards mid on.
Stoinis pushes a back of a length delivery back to the bowler.
Stoinis heaves a full delivery over deep mid-wicket for a big six.
Stoinis attempts a heave but fails to connect with the change of pace delivery.
Connolly cuts a short delivery outside off to deep backward point for one run.
Stoinis defends a back of a length delivery angling into the stumps.
Stoinis cuts a short delivery outside off to sweeper cover for two runs.
Stoinis defends a probing delivery around off stump.
Stoinis slaps a short and wide delivery to sweeper cover for four.
Wayward delivery wide outside off stump, called wide.
Stoinis slaps a high full-toss wide outside off to deep extra cover for four (no ball).
Stoinis clips a full delivery on the pads effortlessly over backward square leg for six.
Fuller length outside off, Connolly throws his bat at it, ball races off the outside half of the bat to deep backward point for four.
Slower short delivery on middle, Connolly pulls it to deep mid-wicket for four.
Slower short delivery, wide outside off stump.
Yorker length delivery just outside off, Connolly fails to dig it out.
Banged in short, Connolly sways out of the line.
Slower and fuller on off, Connolly hits it straight to covers.
Yorker length delivery on middle and leg, Connolly just manages to dig it out to the off side.
Stoinis sweeps a tossed up delivery to fine leg for two runs.
Stoinis creams a tossed up delivery to deep extra cover for a boundary.
Stoinis misses a quicker delivery attempting a cut.
Stoinis edges a quicker googly attempting a cut and is caught by Ishan Kishan.
Shedge cuts a short and wide delivery to sweeper cover for a single.
Connolly punches a short delivery to covers.
Shedge pushes a back of a length delivery to point.
Shedge pushes a full delivery to point.
Connolly works a back of a length delivery to deep mid-wicket.
Shedge guides a slightly short delivery to deep backward point.
Connolly pulls a short delivery to deep mid-wicket.
Shedge works a back of a length delivery to deep mid-wicket.
Cooper Connolly makes room and cuts straight to backward point.
Suryansh Shedge taps a googly to the right of short third man for one.
Suryansh Shedge dabs a googly to short third man.
Cooper Connolly slogsweeps a full ball to deep mid-wicket for one.
Cooper Connolly drives inside-out, wide of sweeper cover for two.
Suryansh Shedge whips it to deep backward square-leg for one.
Drifts into middle and leg, Suryansh Shedge flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flat and wide outside off, Cooper Connolly cuts and misses, a wide called.
Another wide outside off, Cooper Connolly leaves it alone.
On a good length on middle, Cooper Connolly punches it to long-on for a single.
Tossed up full on middle, Suryansh Shedge heaves it for a single to deep mid-wicket.
Dropped short, Cooper Connolly lofts it on the rise to wide long-on for six.
Tossed up full, Cooper Connolly lofts it into the crowd at long-off for six.
Fires a yorker length delivery outside off, Cooper Connolly misses while trying to dig it out.
Suryansh Shedge gets forward to loft a full googly, clearing the long-off fence for six.
Suryansh Shedge flat-bats a short googly to long-off for four, despite a lazy fielding effort.
Suryansh Shedge goes on the back foot and cuts a flat, wide delivery to sweeper cover for a single.
Cooper Connolly drives a very full delivery outside off to sweeper cover for a single.
Suryansh Shedge gets forward to heave a full delivery, but it goes off the inner half to mid-wicket where Cummins stops it.
Suryansh Shedge goes on the back foot and flat-bats a dragged down googly over the sightscreen for six.
Cooper Connolly drives a full delivery back to the bowler.
Cooper Connolly pulls a slower-ball to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Suryansh Shedge drives a full delivery straight to mid-off.

Marco Jansen punches a good length delivery to sweeper cover for a single.

Marco Jansen lets a slower-ball off-cutter go outside off stump.

Cooper Connolly pulls a short delivery to deep mid-wicket for two runs.
Cooper Connolly taps a short of length delivery to the bowler.
Cooper Connolly clears his front leg to heave to leg and misses.
Connolly swings too early and misses, hit on the box.
Cooper Connolly looks for the leg-side hoick, top-edges it for 2 runs.
Marco Jansen gets forward to loft, miscues it, falls short of long-on for 1 run.
Cooper Connolly pulls, off the thick inside-edge to the right of short fine for 1 run.
Cooper Connolly is surprised, takes the outside-edge but drops just short of Ishan Kishan.
Marco Jansen flicks a yorker to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Cooper Connolly slams a pull shot for six into the 2nd-tier at deep mid-wicket.
Cooper Connolly drives hard and straight to long-off for a single.
Marco Jansen pulls a short slower-ball to deep mid-wicket for a single.

Marco Jansen flicks a full delivery for two runs towards deep mid-wicket.
Cooper Connolly top-edges a slog, dropped by Shivang at deep mid-wicket for 1 run.
Marco Jansen drives, the thick inside-edge goes to the vacant mid-wicket area for 1 run.
Cooper Connolly slams a full and wide off-cutter straight down the ground for SIX.
Cooper Connolly pulls flat and over deep mid-wicket for SIX.
Cooper Connolly drives and mistimes it down to long-on for 1 run.

Slower-ball off-cutter well wide outside off, left alone.
Low full-toss, Marco Jansen drives to long-on.
Slower-ball off-cutter, Cooper Connolly pulls to deep mid-wicket for two.

Marco Jansen attempts to drive over extra-cover, slices it to backward point and is caught by Harsh Dubey.
Vijaykumar Vyshak dabs a googly, top-edges it for a single to short third man.
Cooper Connolly whips a ball turning into leg-stump to deep mid-wicket for two runs.
Shivang Kumar bowls a wide delivery outside off, left alone by Cooper Connolly.
Cooper Connolly plays a falling sweep for four, reaching his first IPL century.
Shivang Kumar bowls another wide delivery outside off, left alone by Cooper Connolly.
Cooper Connolly backs away and powers a flat-batted shot over long-off for six.
